item.title: WhatsApp message encryption explained: What is the Signal protocol?
item.description: The recent bombshell lawsuit filed in San Francisco has sent ripples through the tech world, fueled by whistleblower claims that Meta’s “end-to-end encryption” might have a secret backdoor.
